title: They didn’t just hear God.
paragraphs: They didn’t just hear God.
They begged Him to stop.

At Mount Sinai, the ground shook.
Thunder cracked like judgment.
Fire crowned the mountain.
And the people?
They stepped back.
Far back.
“Don’t let God speak to us… or we will die.” (Exodus 20:19)
Here’s what most people miss:

It wasn’t just fear of power.
It was exposure.

Sinai didn’t just reveal God’s holiness.
It exposed their unholiness.

Every command thundered was a mirror.
No idols. No lies. No lust. No pride.
And suddenly…
They realized they couldn’t stand.

Not because God was cruel—
but because He was pure.
And they were not.
But here’s what we miss…
Sinai was never meant to be the final scene.

Because what they feared—
Jesus fulfilled.

The same God who descended in fire
would later hang on a cross.
Not with thunder.
But with nails.

The people said, “Don’t let God come near.”
But in Christ, God came closer than ever.

He took the judgment Sinai warned about.
He carried the holiness we couldn’t reach.
So now?
We don’t run from the mountain.
We run to the Savior.

If Sinai reveals your fear,
Calvary reveals your way out.
You don’t have to stand at a distance anymore.

Through Jesus, you can come near—
not in terror…
but in grace.
“We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.”
